name: nested
source: export function choose(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean) { if (a) { if (b) { if (c) { return 1; } } } return 0; }

name: guards
source: export function choose(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean) { if (!a) return 0; if (!b) return 0; if (!c) return 0; return 1; }

name: extracted
source:
function inner(b: boolean, c: boolean) { if (b) { if (c) return 1; } return 0; }
export function choose(a: boolean, b: boolean, c: boolean) { if (a) return inner(b, c); return 0; }

name: legitimate-dispatch
source: export function decode(x: string) { switch (x) { case 'red': return 1; case 'green': return 2; case 'blue': return 3; case 'white': return 4; default: return 0; } }

name: direct
source: export function api(x: number) { return x + 1; }

name: forwarding-layers
identical-expression-positive
source: export function same(x: number) { return x - x; }

name: identical-expression-negative
source: export function different(x: number, y: number) { return x - y; }

name: identical-condition-positive
source: export function check(x: number) { if (x > 0) return 1; else if (x > 0) return 2; return 0; }

name: identical-condition-negative
source: export function check(x: number) { if (x > 0) return 1; else if (x < 0) return 2; return 0; }

name: overwrite-positive
source: export function fill(xs: number[]) { xs[0] = 1; xs[0] = 2; return xs; }

name: overwrite-negative
source: export function fill(xs: number[]) { xs[0] = 1; xs[1] = 2; return xs; }
